scripts.dev:server: npm run wsl:sync && cd apps/server && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@college-erp/shared && cd apps/web && npm run build
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=@college-erp/shared && cd apps/server && npm run build
scripts.db:generate: npm run wsl:sync && cd apps/server && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:push: npm run wsl:sync && cd apps/server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: npm run wsl:sync && cd apps/server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: npm run wsl:sync && cd apps/server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:studio: npm run wsl:sync && cd apps/server && npx prisma studio
